# The Tender Desk

> The Tender Desk builds websites, writes tenders, runs Google Ads, sets up AI assistants and optimises sites for search and AI answers, for small and local businesses that want more of the right work. Founded and run by Yusuf Imthiyas. Contact: hello@thetenderdesk.co.uk

## Services
Every job is quoted individually after a quick chat. No fixed price list.
* [Websites](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/websites/): custom, mobile first sites.
* [Care plans](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/websites/#care): hosting, backups, updates and small changes.
* [SEO and AI search optimisation](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/websites/#seo): schema, FAQ markup, llms.txt, search structure.
* [Google Business Profile setup](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/websites/#google-business)
* [Google Ads](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/google-ads/): campaigns built and managed.
* [Tender writing](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/tenders/): finding contracts, go or no go, method statements, quality answers, social value, PQQ, SQ and frameworks.
* [AI assistant and automation](https://thetenderdesk.co.uk/ai/): an assistant that answers and books customers 24/7, plus admin automations.
